Syntax:
ara::core::Optional<std::uint16_t> bit_depth;
Description:
std::uint16_t optional member variable which represents the IEEE1722 defined bit_depth 8 bit
header field of an IEEE1722 stream with subtype AAF.
The value range for event shall be:
0x00 00...0x00 FF : valid
0x01 00...0xFF FF : not used
For transmission, the middleware shall set value of bit_depth to the configured value, if it is not
provided by the application.

protected
